model: frozen two-state switching AR HMM trained in preceding retrospective experiment
response_equations: dX=(1.5-.15 X-1.5 U)dt+sigma dW; dU=(Y-U)/tau dt
T2_definition: first 2 consecutive significant downward X deviations from learned no-event trajectory mean; threshold calibrated on whole null trajectories
T3_definition: first 2 consecutive significant negative-regime forward HMM posterior scores; threshold calibrated on same null trajectories
integration: exact joint deterministic step for X,U with exact OU process-noise variance; no Euler approximation
censoring: first alarms before T1 counted separately; no restart at true T1; non-early non-detected cells retained as failures; delay conditional on valid first alarm, capped delay assigns 15 seconds to every early/missing trial
